sources.entry: Sublime Text essential plugins and resources

summary.one_liner: A curated, link-based bookmark list of Sublime Text resources, including tutorials, plugins, themes, color schemes, and fonts, organized by usage profile.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome"-style list rather than a software project, collecting links for the Sublime Text editor. It starts with setup resources such as the home page, Package Control, unofficial documentation, and shortcut cheat sheets, followed by books, screencasts, news, and community forums. The Extensions section lists plugins under General Purpose and language or workflow profiles (Ruby, Python, JavaScript, client-side, LaTeX, Markdown, documentation tools). The Fun stuff section covers themes, color schemes, alternative icons, and monospace fonts. Entries are short one-line descriptions, and the README says it only includes alive projects with Sublime Text 3 support, with ★ marking Editors' Choice picks.
use_cases: Finding Sublime Text plugins for a specific language or workflow
Setting up a new Sublime Text environment
Learning Sublime Text shortcuts and features
Browsing Sublime Text themes and color schemes
Discovering Sublime Text tutorials and books
notable: Organized into usage profiles such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, LaTeX, and Markdown
Marks Editors' Choice picks with a star symbol
Points to Package Control rather than attempting to list every plugin
Covers themes, color schemes, icons, and monospace fonts alongside plugins
caveats: Not a complete list of Sublime Text plugins; the README defers to Package Control for that
Many entries target Sublime Text 2 or 3, and the README only promises alive projects with ST3 support
Links are given without descriptions of current maintenance status
